title: Why Does the Venus Flytrap Snap So Fast?

scenes.text: The plant that catches insects in 0.1 seconds!
It snaps shut using a built‑in spring mechanism powered by rapid cell swelling.
scenes.label: CELL SWELLING SPRING

scenes.text: Trigger hairs must be touched twice within 20 seconds to fire, preventing false alarms.
scenes.label: DOUBLE‑TOUCH TRIGGER
scenes.query: venus flytrap trigger hairs double touch

scenes.text: Each trap can only snap about 20 times before it dies, so the plant conserves energy.
scenes.label: LIMITED SNAP COUNT
